title: What is a display manager?
summary: A display manager (or login manager) is the graphical screen you see when your computer boots, where you enter your username and password to start your desktop session. It replaces the text-only command line login.

steps.explain: A display manager is a program that starts automatically after boot to provide a graphical login interface. Common examples include GDM (for GNOME), SDDM (for KDE/LXQt), and LightDM (generic).
